mindfulness/forest.welcome: Welcome to this mindfulness meditation, set in the quiet of a forest. Let yourself arrive here, exactly as you are... with no need to change anything. Simply allow your body to settle, and your attention to turn inward.
mindfulness/forest.completion: As this meditation comes to a close, gently invite movement back into your fingers and toes... and when you are ready, slowly open your eyes, carrying this forest calm with you.
segments: Let your eyes softly close... or lower your gaze. Notice the ground beneath you, supporting you like the forest floor. Now, breathe in slowly through your nose for 4 counts... hold for just a moment... and breathe out through your mouth for 6 counts. Feel the air move like a gentle breeze through the trees.

Now, bring your attention to the sounds around you... Imagine the soft rustle of leaves in the canopy, the distant call of a bird... With your next breath, breathe in for 4 counts... and as you breathe out for 6 counts, let your shoulders soften, releasing any tension you may be holding...

Allow your awareness to turn to your breath as it moves through your body... Imagine the cool, earthy scent of the forest floor arriving with each inhale for 4 counts... and with each exhale for 6 counts, feel a warm, gentle release, like sunlight filtering through the leaves...

mindfulness/ocean.welcome: Welcome to this mindfulness meditation... Let's settle into the present moment... together we will use the soothing imagery of an ocean beach to anchor our awareness...
mindfulness/ocean.completion: As this meditation comes to a close... gently bring your awareness back to the space around you... carry this sense of calm with you as you continue your day...
segments: Find a comfortable position... allow your eyes to close or soften your gaze... take a slow breath in for 4 counts... hold gently... and release for 6 counts... imagine the soft sound of ocean waves... feel the warm sand beneath you...

Now bring your attention to your breath... feel the air moving in and out naturally... as you breathe in for 4 counts... imagine the cool ocean breeze touching your face... breathe out for 6 counts... let your shoulders soften... listen to the gentle rhythm of the waves...

Continue breathing slowly... in for 4 counts... and out for 6... bring your awareness to the points where your body meets the ground... as if the sand is gently supporting you... with each exhale release any unnecessary tension... let the steady rhythm of the ocean waves anchor your attention...

mindfulness/mountain.welcome: Welcome to this mindfulness meditation. Let's take this time to arrive fully, settling into a space of calm and presence. There is no need to change anything about yourself—simply allow yourself to be here, just as you are.
mindfulness/mountain.completion: Thank you for taking this time for yourself. As this meditation comes to a close, gently bring your awareness back to the room. Notice the ground beneath you, the air around you, and carry this sense of calm with you as you continue your day.
segments: Let's begin by finding a comfortable seated position... Allow your hands to rest gently in your lap... Close your eyes if that feels right for you... Imagine yourself as a mountain, strong and still... Breathe in slowly for 4 counts... and breathe out for 6 counts... Notice the solid base of your mountain... rooted deep into the earth...

As you continue to breathe in for 4 counts... and out for 6 counts... notice the steady presence of your mountain... Feel its unchanging nature, even as weather passes by... Thoughts and feelings may drift like clouds around the peak... Simply observe them, without needing to hold on... Return again to the breath... in for 4... out for 6... resting in the stillness of the mountain within...

Now bring your awareness to the summit of your mountain... Feel the vast sky around you... With each breath in for 4 counts... and out for 6 counts... allow any tension to dissolve like mist... Your mountain remains calm and unmoved... Notice the quiet strength that lives within you... Simply rest here, breathing in for 4... and out for 6... grounded and present...

mindfulness/nature.welcome: Welcome to this peaceful mindfulness meditation. Settle into a comfortable position, and allow your eyes to softly close or lower your gaze...
mindfulness/nature.completion: Thank you for meditating with me today. Gently bring your awareness back to the room, wiggle your fingers and toes, and when you're ready, open your eyes with a soft smile.
segments: Begin by noticing your natural breath... Now breathe in slowly through your nose for a count of four... and breathe out through your mouth for a count of six... Feel your chest and belly rise and fall... Imagine standing at the edge of a quiet forest, the air fresh and cool... Continue this gentle rhythm as we settle in.

Keep breathing in for four counts... and out for six... With each inhale, draw in the fresh forest air, and with each exhale, let go of any tightness... Notice the gentle rustle of leaves overhead... and the soft ground beneath you... If your thoughts drift, simply bring your awareness back to your breath and the peaceful nature around you...

Continue your steady breath... in for four counts, and out for six... Feel the rhythm of the forest around you... Imagine a soft breeze moving through the trees, carrying a sense of calm... Let your shoulders drop and your jaw soften with each exhale... If a thought appears, simply acknowledge it and return to the breath and the gentle sounds of nature...

breathing/nature.welcome: Welcome to this peaceful breathing meditation. Let yourself settle into comfort... and allow the gentle rhythm of nature to guide you.
breathing/nature.completion: Take a final deep breath... and when you're ready, gently open your eyes, carrying this calm with you.
segments: Find a comfortable position... and bring your awareness to your breath. Imagine a soft meadow at dawn... the air fresh and still. Breathe in slowly for 4 counts... 1... 2... 3... 4... and breathe out gently for 6 counts... 1... 2... 3... 4... 5... 6... Let each breath feel like a light breeze through the grass.

Now imagine you are beside a calm forest stream... the water flows gently over smooth stones. As you breathe in for 4 counts... feel the stream's cool mist refreshing you... 1... 2... 3... 4... And as you breathe out for 6 counts... release any tension into the moving water... 1... 2... 3... 4... 5... 6... Let your breath move like the stream, steady and unhurried.

Notice how the stream merges into a still lake... its surface like glass, reflecting the soft blue sky. Breathe in for 4 counts... imagine the stillness entering you... 1... 2... 3... 4... And breathe out for 6 counts... watch ripples fade into calm... 1... 2... 3... 4... 5... 6... With each breath, the lake quiets your mind, leaving only peace.

mindfulness/garden.completion: As this meditation comes to a close, carry this calm with you... You may gently return when you're ready.
segments: Find a comfortable seat... Soften your gaze or close your eyes... Breathe in slowly through your nose for four counts... As you stand in the garden, notice the gentle rustle of leaves... Breathe in deeply through your nose for four counts... and release slowly through your mouth for six counts... Feel the air on your skin and the soft ground beneath your feet... With each breath, let your shoulders soften... Perhaps you catch the scent of blossoms carried on the breeze... Allow your attention to rest here, simply noticing... Continue this easy rhythm as we move deeper into stillness.

Notice the play of light and shadow as the clouds drift... Breathe in for four counts, filling your chest... then exhale for six counts, letting go... Perhaps you hear the soft hum of bees among the flowers... Or the distant song of a bird... Simply observe without needing to name or follow... Keep your breathing slow and steady... Imagine the petals of a rose unfolding with each inhale... and softening with each exhale... Stay with this for a few more breaths.

breathing/ocean.welcome: Welcome... this is a space for you to simply breathe and be present... I invite you to settle into a comfortable position, allowing your body to feel supported... breathing/ocean.completion: Thank you for sharing this time with me... May you carry this sense of calm and presence with you... When you are ready, gently begin to bring your awareness back to the room... and slowly open your eyes.
segments: Take a moment to arrive... Notice the sounds of the ocean... the soft rhythm of waves washing ashore... As you settle in, begin to breathe in slowly through your nose for a count of 4... and then exhale gently through your mouth for a count of 6... Let each breath be like a wave, rising and falling... feel your shoulders relax as you continue this steady, soothing rhythm...

Now as you continue to breathe in for 4 counts... and out for 6 counts... let your awareness settle into the natural rhythm of your breath... Imagine the cool ocean breeze brushing gently across your skin with each inhale, drawing in fresh, clear energy... and with each exhale, feel the wave recede, carrying away any lingering tension or thoughts... Notice the rise and fall of your chest, the gentle movement of your belly, as steady as the tide... If your mind wanders, simply return to the count and the soothing sound of the waves... in for 4... out for 6...

Let the counting go now... and let the breath carry itself. In... and out. Let a quiet shoreline hold you for a moment longer. Nothing to change... nothing to do... just this breath, and the next one.

As you breathe, imagine yourself as that mountain... rooted deep into the earth... your spine tall like a ridge... your mind as clear as the sky above... Continue to breathe in through your nose for four counts... one... two... three... four... and out through your mouth for six counts... one... two... three... four... five... six...
